description:
*** STUNNING THREE BED END OF TERRACE FOR SALE LOCATED IN THE POPULAR ELDER HEATH ESTATE***

Byrne Malone Estate Agents are delighted to present 3 Elder Heath Villas to the market. This stunning three-bedroom (three bathroom) family home is ideally located on the highly sought-after Elder Heath development close to all local amenities overlooking a beautiful green area with local schools, shops, parks, leisure facilities all within walking distance as is the LUAS and The Square Shopping Centre.

The N81, N7 and M50 are just minutes away by car. Presented in pristine condition throughout this bright and spacious, A-rated family home offers super modern living accommodation that briefly comprises of an entrance hallway with W.C main sitting room that flows seamlessly into a stunning open-plan kitchen/diner with separate utility room.

Upstairs, there are three generously sized bedrooms all complete with fitted wardrobes each offering ample space and natural light. The family bathroom is part tiled and finished to a high standard, providing a clean and contemporary feel.

Outside, the property continues to impress with a beautiful rear garden, designed with entertaining in mind. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying quiet evenings, this outdoor
space offers both style and privacy.
Many additional benefits include full double glazing throughout, gas-fired heating, integrated kitchen appliances, fitted wardrobes to all bedrooms, alarm system, outside tap shed.

To view this exceptional home please call us on 01 912 5500
